Governance_Rules.rule_description: Search existing certified/promoted assets and shared semantic models before creating new content.
Use approved KPI definitions unless an exception is explicitly documented.
Production analytics need an accountable owner.
Recommendations affecting important pharma reports should show upstream models and downstream impact.
High-audience content should be certified/promoted or reviewed.
Legacy Tableau assets should be rationalised before migration; duplicate low-use content should not be recreated 1:1.
Business-friendly metric names, explicit measures and clear date semantics should be preferred for agentic analytics.
AI should cite metadata, usage, KPI, lineage and governance evidence behind reuse/consolidate/retire/migrate/new-build recommendations.
